title: A .env on the VPS holding a non-UTF-8 byte makes _read_env_file raise a raw UnicodeDecodeError (drivers/ssh.py runs ssh with text=True, strict decode); its except at deployer_ssh.py:~1118 lists RuntimeError/OSError/TimeoutExpired only, so the ValueError subclass escapes _persist_git_sha's fail-open handler and crashes a redeploy, including inside its rollback.
